summary: The compliance review of LoanBazaar: Personal Loan Marketplace identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The key findings include: (1) The offer screen does not include the APR, monthly repayment obligation, and penal charges in the digital view of loan offers, which are only available in the KFS after an offer is selected.
